blocks.text: Any employee who has a grievance shall confer with the employee’s supervisor within five working days of the incident causing the grievance. (Ord. 20206 § 28, 9-10-19. Code 1981 § 31-290. Code 1995 § 106-92. Formerly 2.125.260.)
